# About HarishFresh
HarishFresh is a modern, fast, and scalable e-commerce platform dedicated to delivering fresh groceries—including vegetables, fruits, dry fruits, and millets—directly to customers. 

# Platform Overview
The platform connects customers with high-quality farm-fresh produce. It provides a seamless shopping experience with features such as intelligent product search, category filtering, cart management, seamless checkout, and WhatsApp-integrated order communications.

# Core Features
- Intelligent Product Search & Filtering
- Pagination and Infinite Scrolling for scalable catalog browsing
- Order Management and Tracking
- Dynamic Delivery and Pricing Calculation
- WhatsApp integration for Bulk Orders and direct communication

# Technology Overview
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TailwindCSS, Zustand
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (PostgreSQL), Python
- Image Processing: ImageKit, Pillow
- Payments: Razorpay Integration

# Built By
Developed by Sivinda.
